main_body: A flat ground patch of green grass-like texture with small scattered tufts. It is terrain with no standing volume, and it does not look like a desert despite the name.
top_band: none. This is a flat terrain tile, so there is no standing object and no top/front split to read.
evidence: The 3/4 contract does not apply to a terrain tile. The patch is a uniform ground texture with no vertical faces or standing volume, so there is nothing to fail on view construction.

style.evidence: The ground has about four green steps: a base, a darker green, a lighter green and a pale highlight on the tuft crosses. The tufts are sparse and the same motif repeats at an identical 16px period in both directions, so every tile carries the same few marks. Between the tufts are open areas of one flat base green larger than 5x5 px. The reference grass has more varied blade clumps, per-patch tonal variation and extra dark and light depth. Next to it the candidate reads as a thinner, mechanically tiled fill with low per-tile density.
